name: thigh_free
assumptions: PILOT. Load cases are ASSUMED, not measured: replace them with the wrenches logged at the knee from the walking policy. Material is isotropic with an assumed modulus: results are a comparison with the current bone under the same loads, not safety factors. Knee keep-out uses 0..120 deg only: the CURRENT CAD femur already touches the shank assembly from about 123 deg (URDF limit is 165 deg, copied from the reference robot) - to be confirmed at fine resolution. FREE MODE: no CAD bone as input. Only the motors, their screw holes (found in the motor meshes) and the keep-outs. Baseline numbers = current CAD femur at 4 mm. Forces act on the leg line (hip-yaw axis, y = -127), not at the motor centre. Knee: mounting face of the motor body at y = -129.4 and plate 10 mm thick as in the CAD; the shank plate starts 2.1 mm further out, so the M4 heads are counterbored 4.5 mm into the plate.
